knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Each person who controls the roof, the common property or any solar equipment must approve access. One occupant's request, a forecast or another business's quote does not establish authority.
Roof repairs and re-sheeting are excluded from a soft wash scope. The method, products and times are inclusions in the scope, not exclusions.
The height hierarchy starts by checking whether any part of the job can be done from the ground. Fall-arrest and roof access by ladder are later options, not the first question.
Deciding that a roof is structurally sound and not fragile is a specialist determination. A worker records visible conditions, photographs them and reports them.

The NSW SafeWork code for work on roofs (cover dated May 2026) excludes residential roofs, and its text does not mention gutter cleaning or soft washing, so the soft-washing position is only partly confirmed.

practicalCriteria: The learner identifies the owner, the body corporate or strata manager, any solar array owner and the occupant, and records each approval needed.
The learner writes a scope with included areas, method and exclusions, on a paper job pack.
The learner marks at least one roof area as an unknown and does not describe it as sound.
The learner issues a hold notice when authority or a roof assessment is missing, and names the person who must resolve it.
passRule: Knowledge checks: 80% correct (4 of 5). Practical sign-off is assessed separately on a paper job pack. The knowledge pass does not verify roof-work competence.
evidenceRequired: Ownership and approval record for the roof, any solar array and any common property
Verified and unknown items recorded separately
Hold or referral record with the person notified
stopWorkCriteria: The learner schedules roof access without approval from each person who controls the roof, common property or solar equipment.
The learner describes a roof as structurally sound or non-fragile without a competent assessment.
The learner omits the exclusions from the scope.
The learner continues work after a fragile or unprotected skylight is found.
